title: Localized cotangent conditions descend along a field extension
statement: Under the hypotheses of the field-extension descent lemma, the localized Kähler differentials at the contracted prime are projective and the localized first cotangent homology is subsingleton.

source.place: Lemma 00TG, faithful-flat descent of cotangent conditions

proof.text: Use flat base change for cotangent homology and Kähler differentials, then faithful-flat descent after localization.

lean.statement:
theorem fieldExtension_cotangent_conditions
    {k : Type u} {K : Type v} {S : Type w}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [FiniteType k S]
    (qK : PrimeSpectrum (K ⊗[k] S)) (hsmooth : IsSmoothAtPrime K qK) :
    Module.Projective (Localization.AtPrime
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap
        (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK).asIdeal)
      (KaehlerDifferential k (Localization.AtPrime
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK).asIdeal)) ∧
      Subsingleton (H1Cotangent k (Localization.AtPrime
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK).asIdeal))
